subject: Unscheduled tenant isolation hotfix — immediate action required
messages:
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Morgan Li <morgan.li@acmehealth.com>, Acme Health - Platform Ops <infra@acmehealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 02:15:00 +0000
Subject: Unscheduled tenant isolation hotfix — immediate action required

Hi Morgan / Acme ops team —

We're sending a short-notice maintenance advisory: our telemetry detected a tenant-isolation edge case that can (rarely) surface as cross-tenant memory bleed in high-concurrency Dedicated pools. We have a mitigation that eliminates the window; it requires a 15–20 minute rolling hotfix that will briefly (under 90s per node) restart inference workers in your Dedicated pool.

What we need from you: please confirm whether you can tolerate a <2 minute interruption to in-flight requests per replica within the next 30 minutes. If you have live traffic that cannot be retried, reply and we'll coordinate an alternate window.

Attachments: redwood_hotfix_instructions_v1.pdf (patch steps), runbook_snippet.txt

Summary of user impact:
- Brief in-flight request failures during worker restarts (clients using standard retry/backoff will not lose requests)
- No customer data exfiltration observed; this is an isolation integrity fix for memory handling only

We will:
- Apply hotfix to one replica at a time, monitor KV/cache integrity, and roll through the pool
- Keep you updated in this thread and on the incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INF-4821

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Morgan Li <morgan.li@acmehealth.com>

Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 02:24:37 +0000
Subject: Re: Unscheduled tenant isolation hotfix — immediate action required

Lauren —

Thanks for the heads up. We run latency-sensitive inference for patient triage; even a brief interruption is risky during morning batch. Can you confirm the exact start time and whether there will be per-request retries visible to our app? We have an active on-call — cc'ed infra@acmehealth.com as well.

Morgan Li
Head of Platform, Acme Health

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Morgan Li <morgan.li@acmehealth.com>, Acme Health - Platform Ops <infra@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 02:33:10 +0000
Subject: RE: Unscheduled tenant isolation hotfix — immediate action required

Team —

We can target a start at 02:40 UTC (in ~7 minutes). Technical notes and mitigation:
- Hotfix is a kernel-level allocator patch (non-persistent change to worker runtime) + worker restart.
- Each worker restart takes ~75s on our Dedicated n1-standard-16 style instances; we will drain connections and re-establish KV caches.
- Client recommendation: exponential backoff with a 500–1000ms first retry is sufficient; SDKs with automatic streaming reconnect will resume.

Steps I will run (high level):
1) Snapshot metrics and tracer span id (INF-4821)
2) Drain node replica A, apply patch, restart worker, run smoke script (smoke: 3 quick inferences + KV sanity checks)
3) Promote replica A back to rotation, wait 90s, then proceed to next replica

I'll attach the runbook snippet and the short checklist (attached). I will post live progress to the status page and update here every replica. If Acme cannot accept the window, we can delay to 05:00 UTC but that risks a longer exposure window.

-Priyom
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
Attachments: runbook_snippet.txt

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Morgan Li <morgan.li@acmehealth.com>, Acme Health - Platform Ops <infra@acmehealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 03:05:12 +0000
Subject: Re: Unscheduled tenant isolation hotfix — immediate action required

Morgan — thanks for confirming. We will begin at 02:40 UTC as planned. Key items for Acme:
- Expected visible behavior: very short 1xx–5xx errors for in-flight requests on the worker being restarted. Retries should succeed; if you need us to hold traffic, we can coordinate a longer maintenance window.
- Post-fix verification: we will share smoke run results and KV checks; expected next update in ~10 minutes once the first replica completes.

We appreciate you standing by. We'll follow up with a short postmortem and an action plan to include an SLA credit if you see measurable client impact tied to this event.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
